featured_reviews.name: Elaine Gia
featured_reviews.review_text: I made my 7 year old daughter join the music school for piano in the month of Jan, had very high expectations that she will learn and continue her passion in music, but sadly I am writing this review to highlight how unprofessional the owner Mr. Akoi is and how he does not value small children's effort of coming weekly and learning inspite of their school and studies, and he did not even think twice to shut down the classes abruptly. He informed me via what's app that they will discontinue the classes and left us mid way. He being a professional teacher himself, he did not take the responsibility to give parents time to look out for some other classes, or even gave us any indication that he was closing the classes for good.It's very difficult to explain to a child as to why there are no classes and why they can not continue. It clearly discourages them from pursuing anything. What's app is not a mode of giving these kind of information. As a professional you need to be humble and have empathy for the child. I hope he has some remorse, and in future deal with situation like these with more empathy and consideration. No amount of explanation will justify of what you have done and how you have dealt with this delicate situation. MUSIC is a way for kids to express and release their already busy and loaded mind, which now clearly you have destroyed my daughters mindset. Thanks for the what's app message Mr. AKOI.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Thank you for your review, Elaine. However, we do not agree with the concerns raised.

The decision to discontinue guitar and keyboard lessons was an operational one, as we are now focusing solely on drums. This change is unrelated to your child’s effort or performance, and the two should not be correlated.

You were informed about this closure a week in advance via WhatsApp, and the applicable fee was refunded. It appears there may have been a misunderstanding, or the message wasn’t read by you, as the information had already been communicated prior to your visit. Please refer to our chats for the same,

We had also mentioned that our teacher, Yashraj, would be available to continue lessons independently, should you have been interested.

Regarding communication, WhatsApp has been our standard mode of contact with all students for years, without any issues.

We regret the misunderstanding and recommend carefully reviewing future communications to avoid such situations.

Regards,
Akoi
Bombay Music School
